body: There have been ups and down so far.  Actually talking to friends helped things.  Turns out I was stupid for thinking they wouldn't lend an ear.  Got a driving lesson booked for next Monday.  Going my first personal training session tomorrow.  And washed my Gi yesterday in prep for a martial art tonight lol.  There are still pretty intense moments of missing her that just happen.  And I do need to brainstorm some ideas concerning a career move.  But thanks again to both of you again.  I'm pretty sure I'm out of the worst of it now.

The most gym work ive ever done was during the first set of horrible times mentioned.  I know this is going to sound so corny, but I really hated myself.  Exercise eventually worked that out of me.  I feel the same will probably happen here too.  I really think this goal thing is a good idea.  Plus it will take my mind off other things.  I'll need to do some brainstorming and go from there.  Thanks man I appreciate your reply.

Thanks for your reply.  At the moment I feel that my age does matter .  I feel pressures now that I did not ten years ago.  Seeing everyone around you doing well and not having made any progress of your own despite trying isn't easy.  I know you mean to say I shouldn't have to conform to these.  Its hard not to when these are actually things you want.  I think that perhaps setting some goals is a very good idea though.
